# Stories

Instagram-style stories: a horizontal row of avatars, each dissolving into a vertical video via `crossfade="both"` (the circle is not the 9:16 frame, so a geometry morph would look wrong). Inside the viewer, slides are a native snap scroller with a CSS view-timeline rotateY: cards hinge on their leading edge as they enter and on their trailing edge as they leave. Copy the **Package** files ( `index.ts`, the `.svelte` files and `lightbox.css`) into your design system, then wire triggers in your app.

## Source

```ts svelte/src/lib/presets/stories/index.ts
import { Lightbox as Primitives } from '@ramka/svelte';
import Root from './Root.svelte';
import Trigger from './Trigger.svelte';
import Gallery from './Gallery.svelte';

export type { LightboxItem } from './Gallery.svelte';

/** Stories skin: the library primitives with a video-pausing Root, a circular Trigger and the composed Gallery. */
export const Lightbox = { ...Primitives, Root, Trigger, Gallery };
```

```svelte svelte/src/lib/presets/stories/Root.svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { Lightbox } from '@ramka/svelte';
  import type { ComponentProps } from 'svelte';

  let {
    open = $bindable(false),
    index = $bindable(0),
    onBeforeClose,
    ...rest
  }: ComponentProps<typeof Lightbox.Root> = $props();

  let root: ReturnType<typeof Lightbox.Root>;

  /** Opens at `i`, morphing from its Trigger when one is registered. */
  export function show(i = index) {
    return root.show(i);
  }

  /** Closes, morphing back to the Trigger picked by `morphTo`. */
  export function close() {
    return root.close();
  }

  function pauseDialogVideos(scope: Element | null) {
    for (const video of scope?.querySelectorAll('video') ?? []) video.pause();
  }
</script>

<Lightbox.Root
  bind:this={root}
  bind:open
  bind:index
  {...rest}
  onBeforeClose={(ctx) => {
    pauseDialogVideos(ctx.destination?.closest('[data-ramka-content]') ?? ctx.destination);
    onBeforeClose?.(ctx);
  }}
/>
```

```svelte svelte/src/lib/presets/stories/Trigger.svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { Lightbox } from '@ramka/svelte';
  import type { ComponentProps } from 'svelte';

  let { class: className, ...rest }: ComponentProps<typeof Lightbox.Trigger> = $props();
</script>

<Lightbox.Trigger class={['stl-trigger', className]} {...rest} />
```

```svelte svelte/src/lib/presets/stories/Gallery.svelte
<script lang="ts" module>
  /** Item shape for the Gallery: pass the real intrinsic pixel size. */
  export interface LightboxItem {
    id?: string | number;
    name: string;
    avatar: string;
    video: string;
    poster: string;
    alt: string;
    /** Relative time shown in the story HUD, e.g. "2h". */
    time?: string;
    width: number;
    height: number;
  }
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Lightbox } from '@ramka/svelte';
  import StoryVideo from './StoryVideo.svelte';
  import './lightbox.css';

  interface Props {
    items: LightboxItem[];
    ariaLabel: string;
  }

  let { items, ariaLabel }: Props = $props();
  const multiple = $derived(items.length > 1);
</script>

<Lightbox.Portal class="stl-portal">
  <Lightbox.Backdrop class="stl-backdrop" />
  <Lightbox.Content aria-label={ariaLabel} class="stl-content">
    {#if multiple}
      <Lightbox.Previous class="stl-nav stl-nav-prev stl-chrome-gesture-hide" aria-label="Previous">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="m15 18-6-6 6-6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
        </svg>
      </Lightbox.Previous>
    {/if}
    <Lightbox.Stage class="stl-stage">
      {#snippet children({ morphRef })}
        <div class="stl-frame" {@attach morphRef}>
          <Lightbox.Slides aria-label="Stories" aria-roledescription="carousel" preload={1} class="stl-slides">
            {#each items as item, i (item.id ?? i)}
              <Lightbox.Slide class="stl-slide">
                <Lightbox.Item index={i} aria-roledescription="slide" aria-label="{i + 1} of {items.length}">
                  {#snippet children({ active })}
                    <Lightbox.Media
                      width={item.width}
                      height={item.height}
                      class="stl-media stl-card"
                      style="background-image: url({item.poster}); background-size: cover; background-position: center"
                    >
                      <StoryVideo
                        src={item.video}
                        poster={item.poster}
                        alt={item.alt}
                        width={item.width}
                        height={item.height}
                        {active}
                      />
                      <div class="stl-hud">
                        <div class="stl-progress" aria-hidden="true">
                          {#each items as _, j (j)}
                            <span class="stl-progress-seg" data-state={j === i ? 'current' : j < i ? 'past' : 'future'}
                            ></span>
                          {/each}
                        </div>
                        <div class="stl-meta">
                          <img src={item.avatar} alt="" class="stl-meta-avatar" draggable="false" />
                          <div class="stl-meta-text">
                            <span class="stl-meta-name">{item.name}</span>
                            {#if item.time}<span class="stl-meta-time">{item.time}</span>{/if}
                          </div>
                          <Lightbox.Close class="stl-close" aria-label="Close">
                            <svg
                              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                              fill="none"
                              stroke="currentColor"
                              stroke-width="1.75"
                              aria-hidden="true"
                            >
                              <path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
                            </svg>
                          </Lightbox.Close>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </Lightbox.Media>
                  {/snippet}
                </Lightbox.Item>
              </Lightbox.Slide>
            {/each}
          </Lightbox.Slides>
        </div>
      {/snippet}
    </Lightbox.Stage>
    {#if multiple}
      <Lightbox.Next class="stl-nav stl-nav-next stl-chrome-gesture-hide" aria-label="Next">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
        </svg>
      </Lightbox.Next>
      <Lightbox.Counter class="stl-counter stl-chrome-gesture-hide" />
    {/if}
  </Lightbox.Content>
</Lightbox.Portal>
```

```svelte svelte/src/lib/presets/stories/StoryVideo.svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { Lightbox } from '@ramka/svelte';

  interface Props {
    src: string;
    poster: string;
    alt: string;
    width: number;
    height: number;
    active: boolean;
  }

  let { src, poster, alt, width, height, active }: Props = $props();
  const lb = Lightbox.getLightbox();

  const playing = $derived(active && lb.open && !lb.pulling && !lb.pullDismissing);

  function playback(video: HTMLVideoElement) {
    if (playing) video.play().catch(() => {});
    else video.pause();
  }
</script>

<video
  {src}
  {poster}
  {width}
  {height}
  playsinline
  muted
  loop
  preload={active ? 'auto' : 'metadata'}
  aria-label={alt}
  class="stl-video"
  {@attach playback}
></video>
```

```svelte svelte/src/lib/presets/stories/Demo.svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { Lightbox, type LightboxItem } from './index.js';
  import CloseOnBack from '#lib/gallery/CloseOnBack.svelte';

  const mixkit = (id: number) => `https://assets.mixkit.co/videos/${id}/${id}-720.mp4`;
  const mixkitPoster = (id: number) => `https://assets.mixkit.co/videos/${id}/${id}-thumb-720-0.jpg`;
  const portrait = (gender: 'women' | 'men', n: number) => `https://randomuser.me/api/portraits/${gender}/${n}.jpg`;

  const story = (id: string, name: string, time: string, avatar: string, clip: number): LightboxItem => ({
    id,
    name,
    time,
    avatar,
    poster: mixkitPoster(clip),
    video: mixkit(clip),
    alt: `${name}’s story`,
    width: 720,
    height: 1280,
  });

  const stories: LightboxItem[] = [
    story('maya', 'Maya', '2h', portrait('women', 44), 40065),
    story('julian', 'Julian', '5h', portrait('men', 32), 43000),
    story('noor', 'Noor', '8h', portrait('women', 68), 43785),
    story('eli', 'Eli', '12h', portrait('men', 75), 40064),
    story('sam', 'Sam', '1d', portrait('men', 22), 44852),
    story('priya', 'Priya', '1d', portrait('women', 21), 50000),
    story('tomas', 'Tomás', '2d', portrait('men', 11), 44600),
    story('aisha', 'Aisha', '2d', portrait('women', 17), 40066),
  ];
</script>

<div class="stories-demo">
  <Lightbox.Root
    loop
    viewTransition="snappy"
    awaitImageDecode={false}
    scrollTriggerIntoView={[
      { type: 'onOpenComplete', behavior: 'instant', inline: 'nearest' },
      { type: 'onChange', behavior: 'instant', inline: 'nearest' },
    ]}
  >
    <p class="title">Stories</p>
    <ul class="tray">
      {#each stories as item, i (item.id)}
        <li>
          <Lightbox.Trigger index={i} aria-label="{item.name}’s story" crossfade="both">
            <img src={item.avatar} alt="" width="56" height="56" class="avatar" draggable="false" />
          </Lightbox.Trigger>
          <span class="name">{item.name}</span>
        </li>
      {/each}
    </ul>
    <CloseOnBack />
    <Lightbox.Gallery items={stories} ariaLabel="Stories" />
  </Lightbox.Root>
</div>
```

# Photos app

macOS Photos–style square grid under a sticky, blurred toolbar with a fade gradient and "Library" title.

## Source

```tsx docs/framework/svelte/examples/lightbox/photos-app/page.tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';

import { SvelteDemo } from '../../../../../../../_components/svelte-demo';

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Photos app example · Svelte',
  description:
    'A macOS Photos-style Svelte image gallery: a square grid under a sticky blurred toolbar that opens into a morphing lightbox, built with ramka.',
};

export default function SveltePhotosAppPage() {
  return <SvelteDemo id="examples/photos-app/PhotosApp" />;
}
```

```svelte svelte/src/lib/examples/photos-app/Gallery.svelte
<script lang="ts" module>
  /** One viewer item: full-size source, strip thumbnail, intrinsic size. */
  export interface GalleryItem {
    id?: string | number;
    src: string;
    thumb: string;
    alt: string;
    caption?: string;
    width: number;
    height: number;
  }
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Lightbox } from '@ramka/svelte';
  import X from '@lucide/svelte/icons/x';
  import ZoomIn from '@lucide/svelte/icons/zoom-in';
  import ZoomOut from '@lucide/svelte/icons/zoom-out';
  import './chrome.css';

  interface Props {
    items: GalleryItem[];
    ariaLabel: string;
    backdrop?: 'scrim' | 'solid';
    hairline?: boolean;
    maxZoom?: number;
  }

  let { items, ariaLabel, backdrop = 'scrim', hairline = true, maxZoom = 6 }: Props = $props();
  const showStrip = $derived(items.length > 1);
</script>

<Lightbox.Portal class="photos-app-lb-portal">
  <Lightbox.Backdrop class="photos-app-lb-backdrop photos-app-lb-backdrop-{backdrop}" />
  <Lightbox.Content
    aria-label={ariaLabel}
    class={['photos-app-lb-content', !showStrip && 'photos-app-lb-content-solo']}
  >
    <Lightbox.Slides
      aria-label="Full-size images"
      aria-roledescription="carousel"
      preload={3}
      class="photos-app-lb-slides"
    >
      {#each items as item, i (item.id ?? i)}
        <Lightbox.Slide class="photos-app-lb-slide">
          <Lightbox.Item
            index={i}
            caption={item.caption ?? item.alt}
            aria-roledescription="slide"
            aria-label={showStrip ? undefined : `${i + 1} of ${items.length}`}
          >
            <Lightbox.Zoom {maxZoom}>
              <Lightbox.Media
                width={item.width}
                height={item.height}
                class={['photos-app-lb-media', hairline && 'photos-app-lb-media-hairline']}
              >
                <img
                  src={item.src}
                  alt={item.alt}
                  width={item.width}
                  height={item.height}
                  loading="eager"
                  draggable="false"
                />
              </Lightbox.Media>
            </Lightbox.Zoom>
          </Lightbox.Item>
        </Lightbox.Slide>
      {/each}
    </Lightbox.Slides>

    <div class="photos-app-lb-top photos-app-lb-chrome-hide">
      <div class="photos-app-lb-tip-anchor photos-app-lb-md">
        <div class="photos-app-lb-group">
          <Lightbox.ZoomOut class="photos-app-lb-segment" aria-label="Zoom out">
            <ZoomOut aria-hidden="true" size={16} strokeWidth={2.25} />
          </Lightbox.ZoomOut>
          <Lightbox.ZoomIn class="photos-app-lb-segment" aria-label="Zoom in">
            <ZoomIn aria-hidden="true" size={16} strokeWidth={2.25} />
          </Lightbox.ZoomIn>
        </div>
        <span class="photos-app-lb-tip photos-app-lb-tip-start" aria-hidden="true">Zoom out</span>
        <span class="photos-app-lb-tip photos-app-lb-tip-end" aria-hidden="true">Zoom in</span>
      </div>
      <div class="photos-app-lb-tip-anchor">
        <Lightbox.Close class="photos-app-lb-button" aria-label="Close">
          <X aria-hidden="true" size={18} strokeWidth={2.25} />
        </Lightbox.Close>
        <span class="photos-app-lb-tip" aria-hidden="true">Close</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class={['photos-app-lb-bottom photos-app-lb-chrome-hide', !showStrip && 'photos-app-lb-bottom-solo']}>
      <div class="photos-app-lb-placard">
        <Lightbox.Caption class="photos-app-lb-caption" />
        {#if items.length > 1}
          <Lightbox.Counter class="photos-app-lb-counter photos-app-lb-counter-md-sr-only">
            {#snippet children({ current, total })}{current} of {total}{/snippet}
          </Lightbox.Counter>
        {/if}
      </div>
      {#if showStrip}
        <Lightbox.ThumbnailStrip class="photos-app-lb-thumbnail-strip">
          <Lightbox.ThumbnailStripTrack aria-label="Photo thumbnails">
            {#each items as item, i (item.id ?? i)}
              <Lightbox.Thumbnail index={i}>
                <img src={item.thumb} alt={item.alt} draggable="false" />
              </Lightbox.Thumbnail>
            {/each}
          </Lightbox.ThumbnailStripTrack>
          <span class="photos-app-lb-thumbnail-strip-indicator" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        </Lightbox.ThumbnailStrip>
      {/if}
    </div>
  </Lightbox.Content>
</Lightbox.Portal>
```

```svelte svelte/src/lib/examples/photos-app/PhotosApp.svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { flushSync } from 'svelte';
  import { Lightbox } from '@ramka/svelte';
  import Heart from '@lucide/svelte/icons/heart';
  import Minus from '@lucide/svelte/icons/minus';
  import Plus from '@lucide/svelte/icons/plus';
  import Gallery from './Gallery.svelte';
  import { photoAssets } from './photos.js';
  import './photos-app.css';
  import CloseOnBack from '#lib/gallery/CloseOnBack.svelte';

  let { dir = 'ltr' }: { dir?: 'ltr' | 'rtl' } = $props();

  const photos = photoAssets.map((asset, i) => ({
    ...asset,
    id: `photo-${i}`,
    alt: `Photo ${i + 1}`,
    caption: `July ${(i % 28) + 1}, 2024`,
    favorite: i === 0 || i === 15 || i === 24,
  }));

  const MIN_COLUMNS = 2;
  const MAX_COLUMNS = 10;
  let columns = $state(5);

  function documentDir() {
    if (dir === 'ltr') return;
    const html = document.documentElement;
    const previous = html.getAttribute('dir');
    html.setAttribute('dir', dir);
    return () => {
      if (previous === null) html.removeAttribute('dir');
      else html.setAttribute('dir', previous);
    };
  }

  function zoomTo(next: number) {
    const target = Math.min(MAX_COLUMNS, Math.max(MIN_COLUMNS, next));
    if (target === columns) return;
    if (typeof document.startViewTransition !== 'function' || matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
      columns = target;
      return;
    }
    document.startViewTransition(() => flushSync(() => (columns = target)));
  }
</script>

<div class="photos-app" {@attach documentDir}>
  <Lightbox.Root
    loop
    {dir}
    scrollTriggerIntoView={[
      { type: 'onChange', behavior: 'instant' },
      { type: 'onOpenComplete', behavior: 'instant' },
    ]}
    awaitImageDecode={false}
  >
    <CloseOnBack />
    <div>
      <div class="photos-app-toolbar">
        <div class="photos-app-heading">
          <span class="photos-app-title">Library</span>
          <span class="photos-app-subtitle">{photos.length} Photos · July 2024</span>
        </div>
        <div class="photos-app-actions">
          <div class="photos-app-capsule">
            <button
              type="button"
              class="photos-app-density"
              aria-label="Smaller photos"
              disabled={columns >= MAX_COLUMNS}
              onclick={() => zoomTo(columns + 1)}
            >
              <Minus aria-hidden="true" size={16} />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              class="photos-app-density"
              aria-label="Larger photos"
              disabled={columns <= MIN_COLUMNS}
              onclick={() => zoomTo(columns - 1)}
            >
              <Plus aria-hidden="true" size={16} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="photos-app-grid" style:grid-template-columns="repeat({columns}, minmax(0, 1fr))">
        {#each photos as photo, i (photo.id)}
          <Lightbox.Trigger index={i} class="photos-app-lb-trigger photos-app-tile">
            {#snippet children({ imageRef })}
              <img
                {@attach imageRef}
                src={photo.thumb}
                alt={photo.alt}
                width={photo.width}
                height={photo.height}
                loading="lazy"
                class="photos-app-tile-image"
              />
              {#if photo.favorite}
                <Heart aria-hidden="true" class="photos-app-heart" size={16} />
              {/if}
            {/snippet}
          </Lightbox.Trigger>
        {/each}
      </div>
    </div>

    <Gallery items={photos} ariaLabel="Library photos" backdrop="solid" hairline={false} />
  </Lightbox.Root>
</div>
```

```ts svelte/src/lib/examples/photos-app/photos.ts
/** A local photo: full-size source, a lighter grid thumbnail, and its intrinsic pixel size. */
export interface PhotoAsset {
  src: string;
  thumb: string;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

const sizes: [number, number][] = [
  [1600, 1067],
  [1067, 1600],
  [1600, 1600],
  [1600, 900],
  [1200, 1600],
  [1600, 1200],
];

/** The 48 demo photos shared by the photos app and the infinite feed. */
export const photoAssets: PhotoAsset[] = Array.from({ length: 48 }, (_, i) => {
  const [width, height] = sizes[i % sizes.length];
  return {
    src: `/svelte/examples/photos-app/full/ramka-photos-${i}.jpg`,
    thumb: `/svelte/examples/photos-app/thumb/ramka-photos-${i}.jpg`,
    width,
    height,
  };
});
```

# Photos app (RTL)

The same photos app mirrored for a right-to-left locale — dir="rtl" on Lightbox.Root mirrors navigation, the thumbnail strip, and the arrow keys.

## Source

```tsx docs/framework/svelte/examples/lightbox/photos-app-rtl/page.tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';

import { SvelteDemo } from '../../../../../../../_components/svelte-demo';

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Photos app example (RTL) · Svelte',
  description:
    'The photos app example mirrored for a right-to-left locale: dir="rtl" on Lightbox.Root mirrors navigation, the thumbnail strip, and the arrow keys.',
};

export default function SveltePhotosAppRtlPage() {
  return <SvelteDemo id="examples/photos-app/PhotosApp" props={{ dir: 'rtl' }} />;
}
```

```svelte svelte/src/lib/examples/photos-app/Gallery.svelte
<script lang="ts" module>
  /** One viewer item: full-size source, strip thumbnail, intrinsic size. */
  export interface GalleryItem {
    id?: string | number;
    src: string;
    thumb: string;
    alt: string;
    caption?: string;
    width: number;
    height: number;
  }
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Lightbox } from '@ramka/svelte';
  import X from '@lucide/svelte/icons/x';
  import ZoomIn from '@lucide/svelte/icons/zoom-in';
  import ZoomOut from '@lucide/svelte/icons/zoom-out';
  import './chrome.css';

  interface Props {
    items: GalleryItem[];
    ariaLabel: string;
    backdrop?: 'scrim' | 'solid';
    hairline?: boolean;
    maxZoom?: number;
  }

  let { items, ariaLabel, backdrop = 'scrim', hairline = true, maxZoom = 6 }: Props = $props();
  const showStrip = $derived(items.length > 1);
</script>

<Lightbox.Portal class="photos-app-lb-portal">
  <Lightbox.Backdrop class="photos-app-lb-backdrop photos-app-lb-backdrop-{backdrop}" />
  <Lightbox.Content
    aria-label={ariaLabel}
    class={['photos-app-lb-content', !showStrip && 'photos-app-lb-content-solo']}
  >
    <Lightbox.Slides
      aria-label="Full-size images"
      aria-roledescription="carousel"
      preload={3}
      class="photos-app-lb-slides"
    >
      {#each items as item, i (item.id ?? i)}
        <Lightbox.Slide class="photos-app-lb-slide">
          <Lightbox.Item
            index={i}
            caption={item.caption ?? item.alt}
            aria-roledescription="slide"
            aria-label={showStrip ? undefined : `${i + 1} of ${items.length}`}
          >
            <Lightbox.Zoom {maxZoom}>
              <Lightbox.Media
                width={item.width}
                height={item.height}
                class={['photos-app-lb-media', hairline && 'photos-app-lb-media-hairline']}
              >
                <img
                  src={item.src}
                  alt={item.alt}
                  width={item.width}
                  height={item.height}
                  loading="eager"
                  draggable="false"
                />
              </Lightbox.Media>
            </Lightbox.Zoom>
          </Lightbox.Item>
        </Lightbox.Slide>
      {/each}
    </Lightbox.Slides>

    <div class="photos-app-lb-top photos-app-lb-chrome-hide">
      <div class="photos-app-lb-tip-anchor photos-app-lb-md">
        <div class="photos-app-lb-group">
          <Lightbox.ZoomOut class="photos-app-lb-segment" aria-label="Zoom out">
            <ZoomOut aria-hidden="true" size={16} strokeWidth={2.25} />
          </Lightbox.ZoomOut>
          <Lightbox.ZoomIn class="photos-app-lb-segment" aria-label="Zoom in">
            <ZoomIn aria-hidden="true" size={16} strokeWidth={2.25} />
          </Lightbox.ZoomIn>
        </div>
        <span class="photos-app-lb-tip photos-app-lb-tip-start" aria-hidden="true">Zoom out</span>
        <span class="photos-app-lb-tip photos-app-lb-tip-end" aria-hidden="true">Zoom in</span>
      </div>
      <div class="photos-app-lb-tip-anchor">
        <Lightbox.Close class="photos-app-lb-button" aria-label="Close">
          <X aria-hidden="true" size={18} strokeWidth={2.25} />
        </Lightbox.Close>
        <span class="photos-app-lb-tip" aria-hidden="true">Close</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class={['photos-app-lb-bottom photos-app-lb-chrome-hide', !showStrip && 'photos-app-lb-bottom-solo']}>
      <div class="photos-app-lb-placard">
        <Lightbox.Caption class="photos-app-lb-caption" />
        {#if items.length > 1}
          <Lightbox.Counter class="photos-app-lb-counter photos-app-lb-counter-md-sr-only">
            {#snippet children({ current, total })}{current} of {total}{/snippet}
          </Lightbox.Counter>
        {/if}
      </div>
      {#if showStrip}
        <Lightbox.ThumbnailStrip class="photos-app-lb-thumbnail-strip">
          <Lightbox.ThumbnailStripTrack aria-label="Photo thumbnails">
            {#each items as item, i (item.id ?? i)}
              <Lightbox.Thumbnail index={i}>
                <img src={item.thumb} alt={item.alt} draggable="false" />
              </Lightbox.Thumbnail>
            {/each}
          </Lightbox.ThumbnailStripTrack>
          <span class="photos-app-lb-thumbnail-strip-indicator" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        </Lightbox.ThumbnailStrip>
      {/if}
    </div>
  </Lightbox.Content>
</Lightbox.Portal>
```

```svelte svelte/src/lib/examples/photos-app/PhotosApp.svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { flushSync } from 'svelte';
  import { Lightbox } from '@ramka/svelte';
  import Heart from '@lucide/svelte/icons/heart';
  import Minus from '@lucide/svelte/icons/minus';
  import Plus from '@lucide/svelte/icons/plus';
  import Gallery from './Gallery.svelte';
  import { photoAssets } from './photos.js';
  import './photos-app.css';
  import CloseOnBack from '#lib/gallery/CloseOnBack.svelte';

  let { dir = 'ltr' }: { dir?: 'ltr' | 'rtl' } = $props();

  const photos = photoAssets.map((asset, i) => ({
    ...asset,
    id: `photo-${i}`,
    alt: `Photo ${i + 1}`,
    caption: `July ${(i % 28) + 1}, 2024`,
    favorite: i === 0 || i === 15 || i === 24,
  }));

  const MIN_COLUMNS = 2;
  const MAX_COLUMNS = 10;
  let columns = $state(5);

  function documentDir() {
    if (dir === 'ltr') return;
    const html = document.documentElement;
    const previous = html.getAttribute('dir');
    html.setAttribute('dir', dir);
    return () => {
      if (previous === null) html.removeAttribute('dir');
      else html.setAttribute('dir', previous);
    };
  }

  function zoomTo(next: number) {
    const target = Math.min(MAX_COLUMNS, Math.max(MIN_COLUMNS, next));
    if (target === columns) return;
    if (typeof document.startViewTransition !== 'function' || matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
      columns = target;
      return;
    }
    document.startViewTransition(() => flushSync(() => (columns = target)));
  }
</script>

<div class="photos-app" {@attach documentDir}>
  <Lightbox.Root
    loop
    {dir}
    scrollTriggerIntoView={[
      { type: 'onChange', behavior: 'instant' },
      { type: 'onOpenComplete', behavior: 'instant' },
    ]}
    awaitImageDecode={false}
  >
    <CloseOnBack />
    <div>
      <div class="photos-app-toolbar">
        <div class="photos-app-heading">
          <span class="photos-app-title">Library</span>
          <span class="photos-app-subtitle">{photos.length} Photos · July 2024</span>
        </div>
        <div class="photos-app-actions">
          <div class="photos-app-capsule">
            <button
              type="button"
              class="photos-app-density"
              aria-label="Smaller photos"
              disabled={columns >= MAX_COLUMNS}
              onclick={() => zoomTo(columns + 1)}
            >
              <Minus aria-hidden="true" size={16} />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              class="photos-app-density"
              aria-label="Larger photos"
              disabled={columns <= MIN_COLUMNS}
              onclick={() => zoomTo(columns - 1)}
            >
              <Plus aria-hidden="true" size={16} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="photos-app-grid" style:grid-template-columns="repeat({columns}, minmax(0, 1fr))">
        {#each photos as photo, i (photo.id)}
          <Lightbox.Trigger index={i} class="photos-app-lb-trigger photos-app-tile">
            {#snippet children({ imageRef })}
              <img
                {@attach imageRef}
                src={photo.thumb}
                alt={photo.alt}
                width={photo.width}
                height={photo.height}
                loading="lazy"
                class="photos-app-tile-image"
              />
              {#if photo.favorite}
                <Heart aria-hidden="true" class="photos-app-heart" size={16} />
              {/if}
            {/snippet}
          </Lightbox.Trigger>
        {/each}
      </div>
    </div>

    <Gallery items={photos} ariaLabel="Library photos" backdrop="solid" hairline={false} />
  </Lightbox.Root>
</div>
```

```ts svelte/src/lib/examples/photos-app/photos.ts
/** A local photo: full-size source, a lighter grid thumbnail, and its intrinsic pixel size. */
export interface PhotoAsset {
  src: string;
  thumb: string;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

const sizes: [number, number][] = [
  [1600, 1067],
  [1067, 1600],
  [1600, 1600],
  [1600, 900],
  [1200, 1600],
  [1600, 1200],
];

/** The 48 demo photos shared by the photos app and the infinite feed. */
export const photoAssets: PhotoAsset[] = Array.from({ length: 48 }, (_, i) => {
  const [width, height] = sizes[i % sizes.length];
  return {
    src: `/svelte/examples/photos-app/full/ramka-photos-${i}.jpg`,
    thumb: `/svelte/examples/photos-app/thumb/ramka-photos-${i}.jpg`,
    width,
    height,
  };
});
```

# Infinite scroll

An endless feed where the lightbox paginates too — one photo array drives grid tiles and slides; the grid loads pages via an IntersectionObserver sentinel, and onValueChange fetches ahead inside the open viewer, appending slides to the native scroll-snap track with a minimal Previous/Next chrome (no thumbnails).

## Source

```tsx docs/framework/svelte/examples/lightbox/infinite-scroll/page.tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';

import { SvelteDemo } from '../../../../../../../_components/svelte-demo';

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Infinite scroll example · Svelte',
  description:
    'An endless photo feed whose lightbox paginates too: swiping near the end fetches the next page and appends slides to the native scroll-snap track while the viewer stays open, built with ramka.',
};

export default function SvelteInfiniteScrollPage() {
  return <SvelteDemo id="examples/infinite-scroll/InfiniteScroll" />;
}
```

```svelte svelte/src/lib/examples/infinite-scroll/InfiniteScroll.svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { Lightbox } from '@ramka/svelte';
  import ChevronLeft from '@lucide/svelte/icons/chevron-left';
  import ChevronRight from '@lucide/svelte/icons/chevron-right';
  import LoaderCircle from '@lucide/svelte/icons/loader-circle';
  import X from '@lucide/svelte/icons/x';
  import ZoomIn from '@lucide/svelte/icons/zoom-in';
  import ZoomOut from '@lucide/svelte/icons/zoom-out';
  import { photoAssets } from '../photos-app/photos.js';
  import '../photos-app/chrome.css';
  import '../photos-app/photos-app.css';
  import './infinite-scroll.css';
  import CloseOnBack from '#lib/gallery/CloseOnBack.svelte';

  const PAGE_SIZE = 12;
  const LOAD_AHEAD = 4;
  const FETCH_DELAY_MS = 800;

  function buildPage(page: number) {
    return Array.from({ length: PAGE_SIZE }, (_, i) => {
      const serial = page * PAGE_SIZE + i;
      return {
        ...photoAssets[serial % photoAssets.length],
        id: `feed-${serial}`,
        alt: `Feed photo ${serial + 1}`,
        caption: `Photo #${serial + 1}`,
      };
    });
  }

  function fetchPhotosPage(page: number): Promise<ReturnType<typeof buildPage>> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve(buildPage(page)), FETCH_DELAY_MS));
  }

  let photos = $state(buildPage(0));
  let loading = $state(false);
  let nextPage = 1;

  function loadMore() {
    if (loading) return;
    loading = true;
    const page = nextPage;
    fetchPhotosPage(page).then((more) => {
      nextPage = page + 1;
      loading = false;
      photos.push(...more);
    });
  }

  function sentinel(node: HTMLElement) {
    void photos.length;
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        if (entries.some((entry) => entry.isIntersecting)) loadMore();
      },
      { rootMargin: '800px 0px' },
    );
    observer.observe(node);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }
</script>

<div class="photos-app">
  <Lightbox.Root
    onValueChange={(value) => {
      if (value >= photos.length - LOAD_AHEAD) loadMore();
    }}
    scrollTriggerIntoView={[
      { type: 'onChange', behavior: 'instant' },
      { type: 'onOpenComplete', behavior: 'instant' },
    ]}
    awaitImageDecode={false}
  >
    <CloseOnBack />
    <div class="infinite-scroll-toolbar">
      <div class="photos-app-heading">
        <span class="photos-app-title">Feed</span>
        <span class="photos-app-subtitle">{photos.length} photos loaded · scrolls forever</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="infinite-scroll-grid">
      {#each photos as photo, i (photo.id)}
        <Lightbox.Trigger index={i} class="photos-app-lb-trigger photos-app-tile">
          {#snippet children({ imageRef })}
            <img
              {@attach imageRef}
              src={photo.thumb}
              alt={photo.alt}
              width={photo.width}
              height={photo.height}
              loading="lazy"
              class="photos-app-tile-image"
            />
          {/snippet}
        </Lightbox.Trigger>
      {/each}
    </div>

    <div class="infinite-scroll-sentinel" aria-hidden="true" {@attach sentinel}>
      <LoaderCircle class={['infinite-scroll-spinner', loading && 'infinite-scroll-visible']} size={20} />
    </div>

    <Lightbox.Portal class="photos-app-lb-portal">
      <Lightbox.Backdrop class="photos-app-lb-backdrop photos-app-lb-backdrop-solid" />
      <Lightbox.Content aria-label="Feed photos" class="photos-app-lb-content photos-app-lb-content-solo">
        <Lightbox.Slides
          aria-roledescription="carousel"
          aria-label="Full-size photos"
          preload={2}
          class="photos-app-lb-slides"
        >
          {#each photos as photo, i (photo.id)}
            <Lightbox.Slide class="photos-app-lb-slide">
              <Lightbox.Item index={i} aria-roledescription="slide" aria-label="{i + 1} of {photos.length}">
                <Lightbox.Zoom maxZoom={6}>
                  <Lightbox.Media width={photo.width} height={photo.height} class="photos-app-lb-media">
                    <img
                      src={photo.src}
                      alt={photo.alt}
                      width={photo.width}
                      height={photo.height}
                      loading="eager"
                      draggable="false"
                    />
                  </Lightbox.Media>
                </Lightbox.Zoom>
              </Lightbox.Item>
            </Lightbox.Slide>
          {/each}
        </Lightbox.Slides>

        <div class="infinite-scroll-nav infinite-scroll-nav-start photos-app-lb-chrome-hide">
          <Lightbox.Previous class="photos-app-lb-button photos-app-lb-md" aria-label="Previous photo">
            <ChevronLeft aria-hidden="true" size={20} strokeWidth={2.25} />
          </Lightbox.Previous>
        </div>
        <div class="infinite-scroll-nav infinite-scroll-nav-end photos-app-lb-chrome-hide">
          <Lightbox.Next class="photos-app-lb-button photos-app-lb-md" aria-label="Next photo">
            <ChevronRight aria-hidden="true" size={20} strokeWidth={2.25} />
          </Lightbox.Next>
        </div>

        <div class="photos-app-lb-top photos-app-lb-chrome-hide">
          <div class="photos-app-lb-group photos-app-lb-md">
            <Lightbox.ZoomOut class="photos-app-lb-segment" aria-label="Zoom out">
              <ZoomOut aria-hidden="true" size={16} strokeWidth={2.25} />
            </Lightbox.ZoomOut>
            <Lightbox.ZoomIn class="photos-app-lb-segment" aria-label="Zoom in">
              <ZoomIn aria-hidden="true" size={16} strokeWidth={2.25} />
            </Lightbox.ZoomIn>
          </div>
          <Lightbox.Close class="photos-app-lb-button" aria-label="Close">
            <X aria-hidden="true" size={18} strokeWidth={2.25} />
          </Lightbox.Close>
        </div>

        <div class="photos-app-lb-bottom infinite-scroll-bottom photos-app-lb-chrome-hide">
          <Lightbox.Counter class="photos-app-lb-counter">
            {#snippet children({ current, total })}{current} of {total}{/snippet}
          </Lightbox.Counter>
          <div class={['infinite-scroll-pill', loading && 'infinite-scroll-visible']} aria-hidden={!loading}>
            <LoaderCircle class="infinite-scroll-pill-spinner" size={12} />
            Loading more photos
          </div>
        </div>
      </Lightbox.Content>
    </Lightbox.Portal>
  </Lightbox.Root>
</div>
```

# URL-synced state

Masonry wall wired to an optional [[id]] route and SvelteKit shallow routing: every photo is a shareable URL, deep links open the viewer on that slide, swiping rewrites the URL in place, and browser Back closes the viewer.

## Source

```tsx docs/framework/svelte/examples/lightbox/url-synced-state/[[...id]]/page.tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';

import { ExampleShell } from '../../../../../../../../_components/example-shell';
import { SvelteDemo } from '../../../../../../../../_components/svelte-demo';
import { svelteDocsPages } from '../../../../../../../../_content/svelte/docs-pages';
import { GALLERY_PAGE_TITLE, galleryPhotos, photoPageTitle } from '@/svelte/src/lib/examples/url-synced-state/photos';

interface UrlSyncedStateRouteProps {
  params: Promise<{ id?: string[] }>;
}

/** Prerender the grid plus every photo permalink. */
export function generateStaticParams() {
  return [{ id: [] }, ...galleryPhotos.map((photo) => ({ id: [photo.id] }))];
}

/** Per-photo title, description and share card on deep links. */
export async function generateMetadata({ params }: UrlSyncedStateRouteProps): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { id } = await params;
  const photo = id?.length ? galleryPhotos.find((p) => p.id === id[0]) : undefined;
  if (photo) {
    const title = photoPageTitle(photo);
    return {
      title,
      description: `${photo.alt}: a deep link straight into the lightbox, driven by a SvelteKit optional parameter and ramka's controlled open / index props.`,
      openGraph: {
        title,
        description: photo.alt,
        images: [{ url: photo.src, width: photo.width, height: photo.height, alt: photo.alt }],
      },
      twitter: { card: 'summary_large_image' },
    };
  }
  return {
    title: GALLERY_PAGE_TITLE,
    description:
      'A masonry lightbox wired to SvelteKit routing: every photo is a shareable URL. Deep links open the viewer, swipes rewrite the URL, browser Back closes it. Built with ramka.',
  };
}

export default async function SvelteUrlSyncedStatePage({ params }: UrlSyncedStateRouteProps) {
  const { id } = await params;
  if (id?.length && (id.length > 1 || !galleryPhotos.some((photo) => photo.id === id[0]))) notFound();
  return (
    <ExampleShell
      title="URL-synced state"
      description={
        <>
          Every photo in this masonry wall is its own URL, driven by a SvelteKit optional parameter: the page lives at
          an [[id]] route, and the lightbox is controlled via bind:open / bind:index on Lightbox.Root. Tapping a tile
          opens the viewer and pushes /docs/framework/svelte/examples/lightbox/url-synced-state/5 with SvelteKit shallow
          routing (goto with shallow: true), swiping rewrites that URL in place (replace: true), and the browser Back
          button closes the viewer. Loading a photo URL cold serves per-photo metadata and opens the viewer as soon as
          the page mounts: deep-link visits render the Portal in place (container=&#123;null&#125;) instead of moving it
          into document.body, and Slides ssrSlideShift paints the right photo on the first frame. Because the URL writes
          happen in the gesture callbacks, trigger taps keep the view-transition morph.
        </>
      }
      docsHref={svelteDocsPages.stateLifecycle.href}
      docsLabel="State & lifecycle docs"
    >
      <SvelteDemo id="examples/url-synced-state/Demo" />
    </ExampleShell>
  );
}
```

```svelte svelte/src/lib/examples/url-synced-state/Demo.svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { Lightbox } from '@ramka/svelte';
  import { page } from '$app/state';
  import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
  import { untrack } from 'svelte';
  import Gallery from './Gallery.svelte';
  import { BASE_PATH, GALLERY_PAGE_TITLE, galleryPhotos, photoIndexFromPathname, photoPageTitle } from './photos.js';

  const COLUMN_UNITS = 120;
  const GAP_UNITS = 9;
  const span = (photo: { width: number; height: number }) =>
    Math.round((COLUMN_UNITS * photo.height) / photo.width) + GAP_UNITS;

  const pathname = $derived((page.shallow?.url ?? page.url).pathname);
  const urlIndex = $derived(photoIndexFromPathname(pathname));
  const deepLinkVisit = untrack(() => urlIndex !== -1);

  let open = $state(deepLinkVisit);
  let index = $state(untrack(() => Math.max(urlIndex, 0)));
  let written: string | undefined;
  let ssr = $state(deepLinkVisit);

  $effect.pre(() => {
    const i = urlIndex;
    if (pathname === written) return void (written = undefined);
    untrack(() => {
      open = i !== -1;
      if (i !== -1) index = i;
    });
  });

  function hydrated() {
    let frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => (ssr = false));
    });
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  function write(path: string, push: boolean) {
    written = path;
    goto(path, { shallow: true, replace: !push });
  }

  function onOpenChange(next: boolean) {
    if (next) write(`${BASE_PATH}/${galleryPhotos[index].id}`, true);
    else write(BASE_PATH, false);
  }

  function onValueChange(next: number) {
    if (open) write(`${BASE_PATH}/${galleryPhotos[next].id}`, false);
  }
</script>

<svelte:head>
  <title>{open ? photoPageTitle(galleryPhotos[index]) : GALLERY_PAGE_TITLE}</title>
</svelte:head>

<Lightbox.Root
  bind:open
  bind:index
  {onOpenChange}
  {onValueChange}
  count={galleryPhotos.length}
  loop
  scrollTriggerIntoView={[
    { type: 'onChange', behavior: 'instant' },
    { type: 'onOpenComplete', behavior: 'instant' },
  ]}
>
  <div class="masonry" {@attach hydrated}>
    <div class="grid">
      {#each galleryPhotos as photo, i (photo.id)}
        <Lightbox.Trigger
          index={i}
          class="tile"
          style="grid-row-end: span {span(photo)}; margin-bottom: calc(var(--masonry-unit) * {GAP_UNITS})"
        >
          <img src={photo.src} alt={photo.alt} width={photo.width} height={photo.height} loading="lazy" />
        </Lightbox.Trigger>
      {/each}
    </div>
  </div>

  <Gallery
    items={galleryPhotos}
    ariaLabel="Gallery photos"
    captionFallback={deepLinkVisit ? galleryPhotos[index].caption : undefined}
    ssrSlideShift
    inPlace={deepLinkVisit}
    portalClass={deepLinkVisit ? ['url-synced-state-in-place', ssr && 'url-synced-state-ssr'] : undefined}
  />
</Lightbox.Root>

<style>
  .masonry {
    max-width: 42rem;
    container-type: inline-size;
  }

  .grid {
    --masonry-unit: calc(100cqw / 249);
    display: grid;
    grid-auto-flow: dense;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    grid-auto-rows: var(--masonry-unit);
    column-gap: calc(var(--masonry-unit) * 9);
  }

  @media (min-width: 640px) {
    .grid {
      --masonry-unit: calc(100cqw / 378);
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }
  }

  .grid :global(.tile) {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 0.75rem;
    background: transparent;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .grid :global(.tile:focus-visible) {
    outline: 2px solid #2b7fff;
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }

  img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 0.75rem;
    object-fit: cover;
    background-color: #f5f5f5;
    transition-property:
      color, background-color, border-color, outline-color, text-decoration-color, fill, stroke, opacity, box-shadow,
      transform, translate, scale, rotate, filter, backdrop-filter;
    transition-duration: 200ms;
    transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  }

  img:hover {
    opacity: 0.9;
  }

  :global(:is(.dark, [data-theme='dark'])) img {
    background-color: #262626;
  }
</style>
```

```svelte svelte/src/lib/examples/url-synced-state/Gallery.svelte
<script lang="ts" module>
  /** One slide of the viewer: pass the real intrinsic pixel size. */
  export interface GalleryItem {
    id: string;
    src: string;
    alt: string;
    caption: string;
    width: number;
    height: number;
  }
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Lightbox } from '@ramka/svelte';
  import X from '@lucide/svelte/icons/x';
  import ZoomInIcon from '@lucide/svelte/icons/zoom-in';
  import ZoomOutIcon from '@lucide/svelte/icons/zoom-out';
  import type { ClassValue } from 'svelte/elements';
  import './lightbox.css';

  interface Props {
    items: GalleryItem[];
    ariaLabel: string;
    captionFallback?: string;
    inPlace?: boolean;
    portalClass?: ClassValue;
    ssrSlideShift?: boolean;
  }

  let { items, ariaLabel, captionFallback, inPlace = false, portalClass, ssrSlideShift = false }: Props = $props();
</script>

<Lightbox.Portal container={inPlace ? null : undefined} class={portalClass}>
  <Lightbox.Backdrop class="url-synced-state-backdrop" />
  <Lightbox.Content aria-label={ariaLabel} class="url-synced-state-content">
    <Lightbox.Slides
      aria-label="Full-size images"
      aria-roledescription="carousel"
      preload={3}
      {ssrSlideShift}
      class="url-synced-state-slides"
    >
      {#each items as item, i (item.id)}
        <Lightbox.Slide class="url-synced-state-slide">
          <Lightbox.Item index={i} caption={item.caption} aria-roledescription="slide">
            <Lightbox.Zoom maxZoom={6}>
              <Lightbox.Media width={item.width} height={item.height} class="url-synced-state-media">
                <img
                  src={item.src}
                  alt={item.alt}
                  width={item.width}
                  height={item.height}
                  loading="eager"
                  draggable="false"
                />
              </Lightbox.Media>
            </Lightbox.Zoom>
          </Lightbox.Item>
        </Lightbox.Slide>
      {/each}
    </Lightbox.Slides>

    <div class="url-synced-state-chrome-top url-synced-state-chrome-hide">
      <div class="url-synced-state-button-group">
        <Lightbox.ZoomOut class="url-synced-state-segment" aria-label="Zoom out">
          <ZoomOutIcon aria-hidden="true" size={16} strokeWidth={2.25} />
        </Lightbox.ZoomOut>
        <Lightbox.ZoomIn class="url-synced-state-segment url-synced-state-segment-divider" aria-label="Zoom in">
          <ZoomInIcon aria-hidden="true" size={16} strokeWidth={2.25} />
        </Lightbox.ZoomIn>
      </div>
      <Lightbox.Close class="url-synced-state-button" aria-label="Close">
        <X aria-hidden="true" size={18} strokeWidth={2.25} />
      </Lightbox.Close>
    </div>

    <div class="url-synced-state-chrome-bottom url-synced-state-chrome-hide">
      <div class="url-synced-state-placard">
        <Lightbox.Caption class="url-synced-state-caption">{captionFallback}</Lightbox.Caption>
        <Lightbox.Counter class="url-synced-state-counter">
          {#snippet children({ current, total })}{current} of {total}{/snippet}
        </Lightbox.Counter>
      </div>
      <Lightbox.ThumbnailStrip class="url-synced-state-thumbnail-strip">
        <Lightbox.ThumbnailStripTrack aria-label="Photo thumbnails">
          {#each items as item, i (item.id)}
            <Lightbox.Thumbnail index={i}>
              <img src={item.src} alt={item.alt} draggable="false" />
            </Lightbox.Thumbnail>
          {/each}
        </Lightbox.ThumbnailStripTrack>
        <span class="url-synced-state-thumbnail-strip-indicator" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      </Lightbox.ThumbnailStrip>
    </div>
  </Lightbox.Content>
</Lightbox.Portal>
```

```ts svelte/src/lib/examples/url-synced-state/photos.ts
/** One photo of the URL-synced state wall; `id` is the stable URL segment. */
export interface GalleryPhoto {
  id: string;
  alt: string;
  caption: string;
  src: string;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

/** Route of the grid; every photo lives at `${BASE_PATH}/<id>`. */
export const BASE_PATH = '/docs/framework/svelte/examples/lightbox/url-synced-state';

/** Title of the grid page. */
export const GALLERY_PAGE_TITLE = 'URL-synced state example';

/** Title of a photo's deep link, shared by the server render and the client. */
export function photoPageTitle(photo: GalleryPhoto): string {
  return `${photo.caption}: ${GALLERY_PAGE_TITLE}`;
}

const sizes: [number, number][] = [
  [800, 1200],
  [800, 533],
  [800, 800],
  [800, 1200],
  [800, 467],
  [800, 1025],
  [800, 533],
  [800, 1200],
  [800, 800],
  [800, 451],
  [800, 1161],
  [800, 800],
];

/** The photo catalogue: grid tiles, slides, prerender entries and 404s all read this one list. */
export const galleryPhotos: GalleryPhoto[] = [
  { id: '1', alt: 'Foggy pine ridge at dawn', caption: 'Dawn ridge' },
  { id: '2', alt: 'Empty coastal highway', caption: 'Open road' },
  { id: '3', alt: 'Overhead of a linen breakfast table', caption: 'Slow morning' },
  { id: '4', alt: 'Narrow sunlit alley', caption: 'Warm alley' },
  { id: '5', alt: 'Wide desert dunes', caption: 'Dunes' },
  { id: '6', alt: 'Rain on a window', caption: 'Rainy glass' },
  { id: '7', alt: 'Calm lake reflection', caption: 'Still water' },
  { id: '8', alt: 'Tall concrete staircase', caption: 'Ascent' },
  { id: '9', alt: 'Close-up of dried flowers', caption: 'Pressed petals' },
  { id: '10', alt: 'Panoramic city skyline at dusk', caption: 'Dusk skyline' },
  { id: '11', alt: 'Single tree in a green field', caption: 'Lone tree' },
  { id: '12', alt: 'Textured stone wall', caption: 'Stonework' },
].map((photo, i) => ({
  ...photo,
  src: `/svelte/examples/url-synced-state/mb-${String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}.jpg`,
  width: sizes[i]![0],
  height: sizes[i]![1],
}));

/** `/…/url-synced-state/5` gives 4; the bare grid URL or an unknown id gives -1. */
export function photoIndexFromPathname(pathname: string): number {
  if (!pathname.startsWith(`${BASE_PATH}/`)) return -1;
  let id: string;
  try {
    id = decodeURIComponent(pathname.slice(BASE_PATH.length + 1));
  } catch {
    return -1;
  }
  return galleryPhotos.findIndex((photo) => photo.id === id);
}
```

# Intercepted routes

The nextgram pattern with SvelteKit shallow routing: plain links whose clicks push the photo URL and open an already-open controlled lightbox over the grid. Back closes it, hard loads get a standalone photo page (one URL, two presentations).

## Source

```tsx docs/framework/svelte/examples/lightbox/intercepted-routes/page.tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';

import { ExampleShell } from '../../../../../../../_components/example-shell';
import { SvelteDemo } from '../../../../../../../_components/svelte-demo';
import { svelteDocsPages } from '../../../../../../../_content/svelte/docs-pages';

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Intercepted routes example · Svelte',
  description:
    'A photo grid wired to SvelteKit shallow routing: clicking a tile pushes the photo URL and opens the lightbox over the grid; loading that URL cold renders a standalone photo page instead. Built with ramka.',
};

export default function SvelteInterceptedRoutesPage() {
  return (
    <ExampleShell
      title="Intercepted routes"
      description={
        <>
          The nextgram pattern in SvelteKit: a grid of plain links whose clicks become shallow routing. Each click calls
          goto(url, &#123; shallow: true, state &#125;) with the photo URL, and the grid renders an already-open,
          controlled lightbox from that state, so the URL reads
          /docs/framework/svelte/examples/lightbox/intercepted-routes/photos/3 while the grid stays underneath. Browser
          Back closes it. Hard-loading the same photo URL skips the shallow state entirely and renders the real
          photos/[id] route, a standalone photo page: one URL, two presentations. Compare with the URL-synced state
          example, which keeps one presentation (grid + viewer) on refresh and keeps trigger morphs.
        </>
      }
      docsHref={svelteDocsPages.stateLifecycle.href}
      docsLabel="State & lifecycle docs"
    >
      <SvelteDemo id="examples/intercepted-routes/Grid" />
    </ExampleShell>
  );
}
```

```svelte svelte/src/lib/examples/intercepted-routes/Grid.svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { page } from '$app/state';
  import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
  import PhotoModal from './PhotoModal.svelte';
  import {
    EXAMPLE_PAGE_TITLE,
    interceptedPhotoTitle,
    interceptedPhotos,
    photoHref,
    type InterceptedPhoto,
  } from './photos.js';

  const selected = $derived(page.state.photo);
  const selectedIndex = $derived(interceptedPhotos.findIndex((photo) => photo.id === selected));

  function intercept(event: MouseEvent, photo: InterceptedPhoto) {
    if (event.button !== 0 || event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    goto(photoHref(photo), { shallow: true, state: { photo: photo.id } });
  }
</script>

<svelte:head>
  <title>{selectedIndex === -1 ? EXAMPLE_PAGE_TITLE : interceptedPhotoTitle(interceptedPhotos[selectedIndex])}</title>
</svelte:head>

<div class="grid">
  {#each interceptedPhotos as photo (photo.id)}
    <a href={photoHref(photo)} onclick={(event) => intercept(event, photo)}>
      <img src={photo.src} alt={photo.alt} width={photo.width} height={photo.height} loading="lazy" />
    </a>
  {/each}
</div>

{#if selectedIndex !== -1}
  <PhotoModal initialIndex={selectedIndex} />
{/if}

<style>
  .grid {
    display: grid;
    max-width: 42rem;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
  }

  @media (min-width: 640px) {
    .grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }
  }

  a {
    display: block;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: 0.75rem;
  }

  img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
    border-radius: 0.75rem;
    object-fit: cover;
    background-color: #f5f5f5;
    transition-property:
      color, background-color, border-color, outline-color, text-decoration-color, fill, stroke, opacity, box-shadow,
      transform, translate, scale, rotate, filter, backdrop-filter;
    transition-duration: 200ms;
    transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  }

  img:hover {
    opacity: 0.9;
  }

  :global(:is(.dark, [data-theme='dark'])) img {
    background-color: #262626;
  }
</style>
```

```svelte svelte/src/lib/examples/intercepted-routes/PhotoModal.svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { Lightbox } from '@ramka/svelte';
  import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
  import { untrack } from 'svelte';
  import Gallery from '#lib/examples/url-synced-state/Gallery.svelte';
  import { interceptedPhotos, photoHref } from './photos.js';

  interface Props {
    initialIndex: number;
  }

  let { initialIndex }: Props = $props();
  let open = $state(true);
  let index = $state(untrack(() => initialIndex));

  function onValueChange(next: number) {
    const photo = interceptedPhotos[next];
    goto(photoHref(photo), { shallow: true, replace: true, state: { photo: photo.id } });
  }

  function onOpenChangeComplete(isOpen: boolean) {
    if (!isOpen) history.back();
  }
</script>

<Lightbox.Root bind:open bind:index {onValueChange} {onOpenChangeComplete} count={interceptedPhotos.length} loop>
  <Gallery items={interceptedPhotos} ariaLabel="Gallery photos" captionFallback={interceptedPhotos[index].caption} />
</Lightbox.Root>
```

```svelte svelte/src/lib/examples/intercepted-routes/PhotoPage.svelte

<div class="page">

  </p>
</div>

  }

    display: inline-block;

    color: #737373;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 4px;
  }

  .back:hover {
    color: #262626;
  }

  :global(:is(.dark, [data-theme='dark'])) .back:hover {

    margin: 0;
  }

  img {
    display: block;

    border-radius: 1rem;
```

```ts svelte/src/lib/examples/intercepted-routes/photos.ts
/** One photo of the intercepted-routes grid; `id` is the stable URL segment. */
export interface InterceptedPhoto {
  id: string;
  alt: string;
  caption: string;
  src: string;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

/** Route of the grid; every photo lives at `${EXAMPLE_BASE_PATH}/photos/<id>`. */
export const EXAMPLE_BASE_PATH = '/docs/framework/svelte/examples/lightbox/intercepted-routes';

/** Title of the grid page. */
export const EXAMPLE_PAGE_TITLE = 'Intercepted routes example';

/** Title of a photo URL, shared by the standalone page and the modal. */
export function interceptedPhotoTitle(photo: InterceptedPhoto): string {
  return `${photo.caption}: ${EXAMPLE_PAGE_TITLE}`;
}

/** URL of a photo, both for the modal (shallow) and the standalone page (hard load). */
export const photoHref = (photo: InterceptedPhoto) => `${EXAMPLE_BASE_PATH}/photos/${photo.id}`;

/** The photo catalogue shared by the grid, the modal and the standalone page. */
export const interceptedPhotos: InterceptedPhoto[] = [
  { id: '1', alt: 'Foggy pine ridge at dawn', caption: 'Dawn ridge', file: 'mb-01', height: 1200 },
  { id: '2', alt: 'Empty coastal highway', caption: 'Open road', file: 'mb-02', height: 533 },
  { id: '3', alt: 'Narrow sunlit alley', caption: 'Warm alley', file: 'mb-04', height: 1200 },
  { id: '4', alt: 'Wide desert dunes', caption: 'Dunes', file: 'mb-05', height: 467 },
  { id: '5', alt: 'Calm lake reflection', caption: 'Still water', file: 'mb-07', height: 533 },
  { id: '6', alt: 'Tall concrete staircase', caption: 'Ascent', file: 'mb-08', height: 1200 },
  {
    id: '7',
    alt: 'Panoramic city skyline at dusk',
    caption: 'Dusk skyline',
    file: 'mb-10',
    height: 451,
  },
  {
    id: '8',
    alt: 'Single tree in a green field',
    caption: 'Lone tree',
    file: 'mb-11',
    height: 1161,
  },
].map(({ file, ...photo }) => ({
  ...photo,
  src: `/svelte/examples/url-synced-state/${file}.jpg`,
  width: 800,
}));
```

# Text message

iMessage-style chat with a single morphTo="origin" trigger over a stack of attachments.

## Source

```tsx docs/framework/svelte/examples/lightbox/text-message/page.tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';

import { ExampleShell } from '../../../../../../../_components/example-shell';
import { SvelteDemo } from '../../../../../../../_components/svelte-demo';

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Text message example · Svelte',
  description:
    'An iMessage-style chat in Svelte where photo attachments open in a morphing lightbox from a single morphTo="origin" trigger, built with ramka.',
};

export default function SvelteTextMessagePage() {
  return (
    <ExampleShell
      title="Text message"
      description={
        <>
          A single{' '}
          <code className="rounded bg-neutral-100 px-1 py-0.5 text-xs dark:bg-neutral-800">Lightbox.Trigger</code> wraps
          an entire stack of attachments. Paired with{' '}
          <code className="rounded bg-neutral-100 px-1 py-0.5 text-xs dark:bg-neutral-800">
            morphTo=&quot;origin&quot;
          </code>
          , the close animation always returns to the stack no matter which attachment is active.
        </>
      }
    >
      <SvelteDemo id="examples/text-message/TextMessage" />
    </ExampleShell>
  );
}
```

```svelte svelte/src/lib/examples/text-message/TextMessage.svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { Lightbox } from '@ramka/svelte';
  import Gallery from '../photos-app/Gallery.svelte';
  import CloseOnBack from '#lib/gallery/CloseOnBack.svelte';

  const messageImages = [
    { alt: 'Screenshot of a changelog notification' },
    { alt: 'Screenshot of a code review discussion' },
    { alt: 'Screenshot of a pull request overview' },
  ].map((image, i) => {
    const src = `/svelte/examples/text-message/msg${i + 1}.jpg`;
    return { ...image, src, thumb: src, width: 1200, height: 1600 };
  });

  const stackRotations = [0, 2, -6];
  const stackOffsets = [
    { x: 0, y: 0 },
    { x: 10, y: -4 },
    { x: -12, y: 8 },
  ];
</script>

<div class="text-message">
  <Lightbox.Root morphTo="origin">
    <CloseOnBack />
    <div class="text-message-thread">
      <span class="text-message-time">Today at 11:11 AM</span>
      <div class="text-message-bubble">some imgs</div>

      <Lightbox.Trigger index={0} crossfade="close" class="photos-app-lb-trigger text-message-trigger">
        {#snippet children({ morphRef, imageRef })}
          <div class="text-message-stack">
            {#each messageImages as image, i (image.alt)}
              {@const offset = stackOffsets[i]}
              <img
                {@attach i === 0 && morphRef}
                {@attach i === 0 && imageRef}
                src={image.src}
                alt={image.alt}
                width={image.width}
                height={image.height}
                class="text-message-attachment"
                style:transform="translate(-50%, -50%) translate({offset.x}px, {offset.y}px) rotate({stackRotations[
                  i
                ]}deg)"
                style:z-index={messageImages.length - i}
              />
            {/each}
          </div>
        {/snippet}
      </Lightbox.Trigger>

      <div class="text-message-meta">
        <svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none">
          <rect x="1" y="3" width="6" height="5" rx="1" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2" />
          <rect x="5" y="1" width="6" height="5" rx="1" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2" />
          <rect x="9" y="3" width="6" height="5" rx="1" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2" />
          <rect x="3" y="8" width="10" height="7" rx="1.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2" />
        </svg>
        <span>{messageImages.length} attachments</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <Gallery items={messageImages} ariaLabel="Message attachments" />
  </Lightbox.Root>
</div>

<style>
  .text-message {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    min-height: 80vh;
    align-items: flex-end;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    border-radius: 1rem;
    background-color: #f5f5f5;
    padding: 1.5rem;
  }
  :global(:is(.dark, [data-theme='dark'])) .text-message {
    background-color: #171717;
  }
  .text-message-thread {
    display: flex;
    max-width: 300px;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-end;
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }
  .text-message-time {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 500;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    color: #737373;
  }
  .text-message-bubble {
    border-radius: 20px 20px 4px 20px;
    background-color: oklch(62.3% 0.214 259.815);
    padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    line-height: 1.25rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #fff;
  }
  :global(.text-message-trigger) {
    position: relative;
    display: block;
    height: 20rem;
    width: 260px;
    border-radius: 1rem;
  }
  .text-message-stack {
    position: absolute;
    inset: -1.25rem;
  }
  .text-message-attachment {
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    top: 50%;
    display: block;
    height: 280px;
    width: 200px;
    max-width: none;
    border-radius: 1rem;
    object-fit: cover;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
  }
  .text-message-meta {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

    font-size: 0.75rem;
    line-height: 1rem;
    color: #737373;
  }
  .text-message-meta svg {
    opacity: 0.4;
  }
</style>
```

# Film trailers

Movie posters morph into a fullscreen <video> that auto-plays on becoming active.

## Source

```tsx docs/framework/svelte/examples/lightbox/film-trailers/page.tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';

import { ExampleShell } from '../../../../../../../_components/example-shell';
import { SvelteDemo } from '../../../../../../../_components/svelte-demo';

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Film trailers example · Svelte',
  description:
    'A Svelte video lightbox example: movie posters morph into fullscreen videos that autoplay on becoming active, built with ramka.',
};

export default function SvelteFilmTrailersPage() {
  return (
    <ExampleShell
      title="Film trailers"
      description={
        <>
          Each poster is its own{' '}
          <code className="rounded bg-neutral-100 px-1 py-0.5 text-xs dark:bg-neutral-800">Lightbox.Root</code> with a
          single-item gallery and a{' '}
          <code className="rounded bg-neutral-100 px-1 py-0.5 text-xs dark:bg-neutral-800">Lightbox.Item</code> snippet
          for the video.{' '}
          <code className="rounded bg-neutral-100 px-1 py-0.5 text-xs dark:bg-neutral-800">
            crossfade=&quot;close&quot;
          </code>{' '}
          hard-cuts the open morph into the video and dissolves the live frame back into the poster on close. Video
          autoplays (muted) only after{' '}
          <code className="rounded bg-neutral-100 px-1 py-0.5 text-xs dark:bg-neutral-800">onOpenChangeComplete</code>.
        </>
      }
    >
      <SvelteDemo id="examples/film-trailers/Demo" />
    </ExampleShell>
  );
}
```

```svelte svelte/src/lib/examples/film-trailers/Film.svelte
<script lang="ts" module>
  /** One Blender open movie: poster for the trigger, video sized to its own frame. */
  export interface FilmItem {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    year: number;
    genre: string;
    poster: string;
    posterWidth: number;
    posterHeight: number;
    video: string;
    videoWidth: number;
    videoHeight: number;
  }
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Lightbox } from '@ramka/svelte';
  import Play from '@lucide/svelte/icons/play';
  import SoloViewer from './SoloViewer.svelte';
  import CloseOnBack from '#lib/gallery/CloseOnBack.svelte';

  let { film }: { film: FilmItem } = $props();

  let readyToPlay = $state(false);

  function playback(video: HTMLVideoElement) {
    if (readyToPlay) {
      video.play().catch(() => {});
    } else {
      video.pause();
      video.currentTime = 0;
    }
  }
</script>

<Lightbox.Root
  onOpenChange={(open) => {
    if (!open) readyToPlay = false;
  }}
  onOpenChangeComplete={(open) => (readyToPlay = open)}
>
  <CloseOnBack />
  <Lightbox.Trigger index={0} crossfade="close" class="film-trailers-trigger">
    {#snippet children({ morphRef })}
      <div class="film-trailers-poster" {@attach morphRef}>
        <img src={film.poster} alt={film.title} width={film.posterWidth} height={film.posterHeight} loading="lazy" />
        <div class="film-trailers-play">
          <div class="film-trailers-play-circle">
            <Play aria-hidden="true" />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="film-trailers-meta">
        <div class="film-trailers-title">{film.title}</div>
        <div class="film-trailers-subtitle">{film.year} · {film.genre}</div>
      </div>
    {/snippet}
  </Lightbox.Trigger>

  <SoloViewer ariaLabel={film.title} caption={film.title}>
    <Lightbox.Zoom>
      <Lightbox.Media width={film.videoWidth} height={film.videoHeight} class="film-trailers-media">
        <video
          {@attach playback}
          src={film.video}
          poster={film.poster}
          width={film.videoWidth}
          height={film.videoHeight}
          controls
          playsinline
          muted
          preload="metadata"
        ></video>
      </Lightbox.Media>
    </Lightbox.Zoom>
  </SoloViewer>
</Lightbox.Root>

<style>
  :global(.film-trailers-trigger) {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 14px;
    background: transparent;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    letter-spacing: inherit;
    text-align: left;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  :global(.film-trailers-trigger:focus-visible) {
    outline: 2px solid oklch(62.3% 0.214 259.815);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
  .film-trailers-poster {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: 14px;
  }
  img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    aspect-ratio: 2 / 3;
    border-radius: 14px;
    object-fit: cover;
  }
  .film-trailers-play {
    pointer-events: none;
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    border-radius: 14px;
    background-color: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25);
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  }
  @media (hover: hover) {
    :global(.film-trailers-trigger:hover) .film-trailers-play {
      opacity: 1;
    }
  }
  .film-trailers-play-circle {
    display: flex;
    width: 3rem;
    height: 3rem;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.95);
    color: #000;
  }
  .film-trailers-play-circle :global(svg) {
    width: 1.25rem;
    height: 1.25rem;
    fill: currentColor;
  }
  .film-trailers-meta {
    padding: 0.625rem 0.125rem 0;
  }
  .film-trailers-title {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    line-height: 1.375;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .film-trailers-subtitle {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    line-height: 1rem;
    color: #737373;
  }
  :global(:is(.dark, [data-theme='dark'])) .film-trailers-subtitle {
    color: #a3a3a3;
  }
  :global(.film-trailers-media) {
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: 14px;
  }
  video {
    object-fit: cover;
```

# 3D models

Three.js product grid with Lightbox.Slides — onBeforeOpen preheats GLBs before the morph; shared orbit with each trigger.

## Source

```tsx docs/framework/svelte/examples/lightbox/3d-models/page.tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';

import { ExampleShell } from '../../../../../../../_components/example-shell';
import { SvelteDemo } from '../../../../../../../_components/svelte-demo';
import { svelteDocsPages } from '../../../../../../../_content/svelte/docs-pages';

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: '3D models example · Svelte',
  description:
    'A Three.js product grid in a Svelte lightbox: onBeforeOpen preheats GLB models before the morph, with a shared orbit between trigger and slide.',
};

export default function Svelte3dModelsPage() {
  return (
    <ExampleShell
      title="3D models"
      description={
        <>
          Each tile is its own{' '}
          <code className="rounded bg-neutral-100 px-1 py-0.5 text-xs dark:bg-neutral-800">Lightbox.Root</code> with a
          single-item gallery, Three.js canvases in the trigger and{' '}
          <code className="rounded bg-neutral-100 px-1 py-0.5 text-xs dark:bg-neutral-800">Lightbox.Media</code>.{' '}
          <code className="rounded bg-neutral-100 px-1 py-0.5 text-xs dark:bg-neutral-800">onBeforeOpen</code> waits for
          the prepared lightbox canvas to paint a synced frame before the morph (spin stays live, like close). Rotate
          only (no zoom); orbit stays in sync with the grid tile.{' '}
          <code className="rounded bg-neutral-100 px-1 py-0.5 text-xs dark:bg-neutral-800">
            pullToClose=&#123;false&#125;
          </code>{' '}
          so vertical drag stays with orbit.
        </>
      }
      docsHref={`${svelteDocsPages.stateLifecycle.href}#before-open`}
      docsLabel="State & lifecycle · onBeforeOpen"
    >
      <SvelteDemo id="examples/3d-models/Demo" />
    </ExampleShell>
  );
}
```

```svelte svelte/src/lib/examples/3d-models/ProductLightbox.svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { Lightbox } from '@ramka/svelte';
  import SoloViewer from '#lib/examples/film-trailers/SoloViewer.svelte';
  import { mountScene, waitForLightboxPainted, type Product } from './scene.js';
  import CloseOnBack from '#lib/gallery/CloseOnBack.svelte';

  let { product }: { product: Product } = $props();

  const FRAME_SIZE = 1024;
  let open = $state(false);
  let orbitReady = $state(false);
</script>

<Lightbox.Root
  awaitImageDecode={false}
  onOpenChange={(next) => {
    open = next;
    if (!next) orbitReady = false;
  }}
  onBeforeOpen={({ signal }) => waitForLightboxPainted(product.id, { signal, timeoutMs: 2500 })}
  onOpenChangeComplete={(next) => (orbitReady = next)}
>
  <CloseOnBack />
  <Lightbox.Trigger index={0} crossfade="both" class="models-3d-trigger">
    <div data-ramka-morph class="tile">
      <div
        class="trigger-scene"
        {@attach (host) =>
          mountScene(host, {
            product,
            role: 'trigger',
            interactive: () => false,
            autoRotate: () => !open,
          })}
      ></div>
    </div>
    <div class="meta">
      <div class="name">{product.name}</div>
      <div class="material">{product.material}</div>
    </div>
  </Lightbox.Trigger>

  <SoloViewer ariaLabel={product.name} caption="{product.name} · {product.material}" preload={0} pullToClose={false}>
    <div class="center">
      <Lightbox.Media width={FRAME_SIZE} height={FRAME_SIZE} class="models-3d-media">
        <div
          class="lightbox-scene"
          {@attach (host) =>
            mountScene(host, {
              product,
              role: 'lightbox',
              interactive: () => orbitReady,
              autoRotate: () => open,
            })}
        ></div>
      </Lightbox.Media>
    </div>
  </SoloViewer>
</Lightbox.Root>
```
